competences.description: Attacks all enemies to remove all beneficial effects and grant Oblivion for 1 turn.

Attacks the enemy with the highest Attack Bar 3 times, dealing damage that ignores Defense based on the difference in Attack Speed between the boss and the target, and decreasing its Attack Bar by 30% on each hit.
Whenever its turn ends, decreases the Attack Speed of all enemies for 2 turns with a 50% chance. [Automatic Effect]
Attacks taken from enemies with lower Attack Speed than the boss always land as a Glancing Hit. [Automatic Effect]
